SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList] AS BEGIN

			
WITH IBGLIST_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(InstitutionalBankingGroupListSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList

)
,
TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList
AS (
SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM IBGLIST_SK) AS InstitutionalBankingGroupListSK
, * from ( 
		SELECT
		DDW.CustomerSK
		,BIL.CustomerID
		,BIL.BusinessUnit
		,1 AS CurrentIndicator
		,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
        ,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
		,BIL.SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
		FROM BNKM.InstitutionalBankingGroupList BIL
		LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDW ON BIL.CustomerId = DDW.CustomerID
		WHERE BIL.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31'
        ) A
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList FROM TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList;

WITH
TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerSK)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerID)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BusinessUnit)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SourceSystemCode)
	)) HASHROW, CustomerSK, CustomerID 
    FROM #TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerSK)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerID)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BusinessUnit)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SourceSystemCode)
	)) HASHROW, CustomerSK, CustomerID 
    FROM DW.DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList  WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerSK,TGT.CustomerSK) AS CustomerSK
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.CustomerSK IS NULL AND TGT.CustomerID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerSK = TGT.CustomerSK
AND SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW --OR (TGT.CustomerSK IS NULL AND TGT.CustomerID IS NULL)
OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
--SELECT *  FROM TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList_DELTA
--WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE';

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList_DELTA FROM TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList_DELTA;



--------UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
    ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
    ,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList TGT
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerSK = TGT.CustomerSK  AND DELTA.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList SRC ON SRC.CustomerSK = TGT.CustomerSK AND SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1;


INSERT INTO DW.DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList (
	InstitutionalBankingGroupListSK
	,CustomerSK
	,CustomerID
	,BusinessUnit
	,CurrentIndicator
	,ValidStartDate
	,ValidEndDate
	,SourceSystemCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm)
SELECT
	InstitutionalBankingGroupListSK
	,SRC.CustomerSK
	,SRC.CustomerID
	,BusinessUnit
	,CurrentIndicator
	,ValidStartDate
	,ValidEndDate
	,SourceSystemCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList SRC
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerSK = SRC.CustomerSK  AND DELTA.CustomerID = SRC.CustomerID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

END
GO
